_comment: Your own manual adjustments, on top of everything the feeds already do. The pipeline never overwrites this file. Keyed by ESPN game_id (visible on every game card and in site/data/games.json). margin_adj is in points and POSITIVE FAVOURS THE HOME TEAM. total_adj shifts the projected combined score. Injuries and weather are already applied automatically -- use this for what no feed knows: a coach resting starters in Week 18, a locker-room story, a number you simply trust more than the model's.

team_adjust._comment: Permanent points added to a team's rating, applied every week until you remove it. Same idea as the workbook's Manual Adj column.
